result.title: Do We Really Need an LLM for Weight-Space Programming? A Deterministic Forward-Only Paradigm and Its Capability Boundaries
result.summary: Recent work on Weight-Space Programming uses LLMs to edit neural weights with forward passes only, conflating LLM scripting with the underlying algebra of forward-only editing. We show that for core structured editing regimes, an LLM optimizer is unnecessary, and introduce Forward Weight-Space Programming (FWSP): a deterministic pipeline combining probing, localization, stratified operators (O1-O4), automatic blind routing (83.3% vs. 33.3% for a 27B LLM with the same tool library), and paired verification with zero additional per-token computation. For reasoning LLMs, we propose Protected FisherGate, a closed-form covariance-whitened readout edit orthogonal to normal-reasoning states: on DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B, a single frozen math-calibrated patch achieves 84.2% HumanEval pass@1 (1K budget; 75.4 +/- 9.4% across 3/5 Stage-4-passing subsets), beating 512-token-reserved budget forcing by +14.6 pp (-23.4% tokens) while transferring across HF-to-vLLM backends on full GSM8K and MATH-500. Across five modalities and thirteen models (50K to 27B dense and FP8 MoE), we further prove and verify two operator boundaries, subspace entanglement and frozen representation span, where FWSP-localized LoRA bridges forward-only and gradient adaptation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文论证结构化权重编辑无需 LLM 优化器，提出确定性流程 FWSP（探测、定位、分层算子 O1–O4、盲路由与配对验证），并给出闭式协方差白化的读出编辑 Protected FisherGate，在推理模型上以单次冻结补丁替代预留 token 的 budget forcing。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结表示跨度」「子空间纠缠」两类算子边界与正交于推理状态的读出编辑，可供核查推理期潜在状态干预的可达范围；与 budget forcing 的对比也涉及 THINK/STOP 的计算—精度权衡，但无视觉输入，能否迁移到 VLM 潜在推理尚待验证。
